arguments.command:
python -c "
import glom

# R1: CLI supports python-full spec format (tested via shell earlier)
print('R1: CLI python-full support verified via shell tests')

# R2: Public API exports
for name in ['Auto', 'Fill', 'Iter', 'Let', 'ROOT']:
    assert hasattr(glom, name), f'Missing {name} in glom'
print('R2: All public API names exported correctly')

# R3: Invoke __repr__
inv = glom.Invoke(lambda x: x, constants={'a': 1})
r = repr(inv)
assert 'Invoke' in r
assert 'constants=' in r
assert 'args' not in r.lower()  # Should not expose internal args
print(f'R3: Invoke repr: {r}')

# R4: Invoke exposes constants instead of consts
assert hasattr(inv, 'constants'), 'Missing constants attribute'
assert inv.constants == {'a': 1}
# Also check that consts is still available for backwards compat
assert hasattr(inv, 'consts')
assert inv.consts == {'a': 1}
print('R4: Invoke constants/consts attributes work correctly')

# R5: Fill __repr__
f = glom.Fill('x', default='y')
r = repr(f)
assert 'Fill' in r
print(f'R5: Fill repr: {r}')

# R6: Assign __repr__ and assign function
asgn = glom.Assign('a.b.c', 'value')
r = repr(asgn)
assert 'Assign' in r
print(f'R6: Assign repr: {r}')
# Test assign function
target = {'a': {'b': {'c': 'old'}}}
glom.assign(target, 'a.b.c', 'new')
assert target['a']['b']['c'] == 'new'
print('R6: assign function works correctly')

# R7: Coalesce and Inspect __repr__
co = glom.Coalesce('a', 'b', 'c')
r = repr(co)
assert 'Coalesce' in r
print(f'R7: Coalesce repr: {r}')

ins = glom.Inspect('x.y')
r = repr(ins)
assert '<INSPECT>' in r
print(f'R7: Inspect repr: {r}')

# R8: Auto and Check __repr__
auto = glom.Auto('test')
r = repr(auto)
assert 'Auto' in r
print(f'R8: Auto repr: {r}')

check = glom.Check(glom.T['a'], type=int)
r = repr(check)
assert 'Check' in r
print(f'R8: Check repr: {r}')

print('\\nAll requirements verified!')
"
